d: Bihar MLC Election Row:bihar men MLC chunav men do nirdaliy pratyashi jite..jit darj karne ke bad bijepi men pahunche... aur bihar ki siyasat men baval mach gaya... rahul raj aur banshidhar brijvasi ki bijepi men entri par aarjedi se lekar jan suraj tak ne morcha khol diya hai...donon nirdaliy MLC ki sadasyata radd karne ki mang tej ho gaee hai...vahin sahyogi jediyu ne bhi BJP ke phaisle par saval khare kar die hain..... ab saval sirph do emaelsi ki entri ka nahin, balki dal-badal kanun aur sahyogi JDU ki ashajta ki bhi hai...riport dekhie...
